description: The article scales each sentence's difficulty by the same method used for vocabulary words: given the per cent of pupils translating it correctly, its position is located on the base line of the normal frequency surface in P.E.
title: Henmon's P.E. sentence-difficulty scaling method

description: The article adapts Buckingham's spelling-scaling method to assign each Latin word a difficulty weight.
title: Henmon's P.E. vocabulary-difficulty scaling method
